Step inside this stunning residence and be prepared to be impressed. Very open and airy with many awesome views of the pool and lake! There are three additional bedrooms and den with great water views!  Stunning pool with waterfalls and fountains, summer kitchen, beautiful pavers and manicured landscaping overlooking the lake.  Convenient to Shopping, restaurants, Schools, I-95 and the beaches.
